title: Northbeam TechWorks Scheduling Standard: Booking and Slot-Move Figures
content:
The scheduling office of Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair works to a set of figures fixed per TechWorks service: the days of notice needed to book a slot, the slots the customer may choose from, the number of times a slot may be moved at the customer's request before a fee applies, the fee for moving a slot beyond that allowance, the hours of notice needed to move a slot without a fee, the hours within which the retailer aims to attend a reported fault, whether the work goes in the priority queue, and whether a remote diagnosis is attempted before a visit is booked.

| TechWorks service | Notice to book, days | Slots offered | Slot moves allowed | Slot-move fee, USD | Notice to move, hours | Response target, hours | Priority queue | Remote diagnosis attempted |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0 | any trading hour at the counter | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 72 | no | no |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 3 | morning or afternoon | 2 | 35.00 | 24 | 72 | no | yes |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 5 | morning, afternoon or evening | 2 | 49.00 | 48 | 96 | no | yes |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 3 | morning or afternoon | 1 | 45.00 | 24 | 48 | no | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 7 | business hours | 3 | 75.00 | 48 | 24 | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 1 | morning, afternoon, evening or all day | 4 | 0.00 | 12 | 8 | yes | yes |

### Notes

- Notice to book runs from 0 days at the store counter to 7 days on a business deployment; the annual care service asks 1 day.
- The slot-move allowance runs from 0 at the counter to 4 on the annual care service, and the fee beyond the allowance from 0.00 USD at the counter and on the annual care service up to 75.00 USD on a business deployment.
- Only the business deployment service and the annual care service put the work in the priority queue, and they carry the two shortest response targets, 24 and 8 hours.
- The bench service is the one TechWorks service under which no remote diagnosis is attempted before a slot is taken.
